idea: Unemployment Claims Spike Triggers Defensive Rotation

data.source: FRED series ICSA (Initial Claims) weekly data via fred_series adapter

behavior: Weekly jobless claims frequently spike 10-15% above 4-week moving average due to seasonal adjustments, weather, or regional shocks. This triggers flight-to-safety rotation out of cyclicals.

market_impact.rationale: Consumer discretionary underperforms when labor market stress signals weaken demand ahead.

trade_logic.entry: If ICSA rises 12% or more week-over-week AND exceeds its 4-week MA by more than 1 standard deviation
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 3 weeks or when ICSA falls back below 4-week MA for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Claims data releases weekly; seasonal swings and weather disruptions cause 10%+ moves several times per quarter.

idea: Diesel Price Surge Signals Freight Cost Inflation

data.source: FRED series GASDESW (Weekly U.S. Diesel Prices) via fred_series adapter

behavior: Diesel prices move sharply on crude swings, supply disruptions, and refinery outages. A 5%+ weekly jump signals margin compression across logistics and manufacturing.

market_impact.rationale: Industrials and transportation companies face immediate margin pressure when fuel costs spike.

trade_logic.entry: If GASDESW rises 5% or more week-over-week and closes above its 8-week high
trade_logic.exit: After 4 weeks or once GASDESW closes below its 8-week MA for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Crude volatility ensures diesel prices spike 5%+ multiple times per quarter; refinery maintenance also triggers moves.

idea: Hotel Occupancy Rate Collapse Signals Travel Recession

data.source: FRED series HOUST2 (Hotel Occupancy Rate) via fred_series adapter

behavior: Hotel occupancy drops sharply during economic slowdowns, pandemics, or post-holiday periods. A 3%+ drop from prior week signals near-term travel demand weakness.

market_impact.rationale: Hospitality and leisure discretionary spending decline when occupancy crashes.

trade_logic.entry: If occupancy rate falls 3% or more week-over-week AND drops below its 12-week MA
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or once occupancy rises for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal dips and economic noise cause 3%+ weekly swings 8-10 times per year.

idea: Core PCE Inflation Acceleration Crushes Growth Stocks

data.source: FRED series PCEPILFE (Core PCE Inflation) via fred_series adapter

behavior: Monthly PCE releases create sharp repricing when inflation surprises above trend. Weekly sampling of FRED data detects momentum shifts 1-2 weeks before major policy reaction.

market_impact.rationale: Tech and growth stocks crater on inflation surprises as Fed tightening prospects increase.

trade_logic.entry: If week-over-week PCE momentum (proxied by consecutive daily/weekly FRED updates) accelerates 0.15% or more from prior week AND exceeds 2.5% annualized
trade_logic.exit: After 4 weeks or once momentum decelerates for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Monthly PCE prints create momentum swings; each print (12 per year) has 40% odds of surprise above trend.

idea: Mortgage Rate Spike Collapses Housing Demand Sentiment

data.source: FRED series MORTGAGE30US (30-Year Fixed Mortgage Rate) via fred_series adapter

behavior: Mortgage rates move 20-40bps weekly on Fed expectations and bond yields. A 3-day spike of 30bps+ collapses homebuilder and real estate confidence almost immediately.

market_impact.rationale: Real estate equities tank when financing costs jump; homebuilders face demand collapse within days.

trade_logic.entry: If 30Y mortgage rate rises 30bps or more over 3 consecutive trading days and closes above its 20-day MA
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or once rates fall 20bps from entry peak

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Bond market volatility ensures 30bps+ 3-day moves occur 4-6 times per quarter.

idea: EV Charger Installation Surge Signals Green Capex Acceleration

data.source: Open Charge Map EV charger count changes (weekly snapshots) via openchargemap adapter

behavior: EV charger networks expand 5-10% quarterly as infrastructure spending accelerates. Week-over-week jumps 2%+ are rare but signal policy tailwinds or corporate expansion announcements.

market_impact.rationale: Tech and infrastructure plays benefit from capex acceleration in EV charging networks.

trade_logic.entry: If total charger count increases 2% or more week-over-week AND closes above its 8-week MA
trade_logic.exit: After 4 weeks or once growth rate normalizes below 0.5% weekly for 2 weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Regional rollouts and permit batches create clustering; 2%+ weeks fire 6-8 times per year.

idea: Earthquake Activity Surge Triggers Insurance Sector Repricing

data.source: USGS Earthquake API (magnitude 4.5+ events) via earthquake_activity adapter

behavior: Multi-week seismic swarms (3+ magnitude 5.0+ earthquakes in 7 days) are rare but signal stress release or volcanic activity. Insurance and reinsurance markets reprice loss exposure sharply.

market_impact.rationale: Insurance/reinsurance companies face reserve raises and premium compression on seismic event clusters.

trade_logic.entry: If 3 or more magnitude 5.0+ earthquakes occur within 7 days in a single geographic cluster AND previous 30 days had 1 or fewer
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or once seismic activity normalizes to historical baseline for 14 days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seismic swarms cluster 2-4 times per year on average; each swarm lasts 7-14 days and triggers repricing.

idea: Natural Gas Storage Draw Signals Winter Energy Demand Spike

data.source: FRED series DHHNGSP (Weekly Natural Gas Storage, US) via fred_series adapter

behavior: Winter draws from storage exceed forecasts when temperatures drop unexpectedly. A 5%+ week-over-week storage decline signals heating demand surge and energy cost inflation.

market_impact.rationale: Energy sector profits from demand spikes and price rises during storage draw cycles.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly storage draw exceeds 5% of current inventory AND draw exceeds prior year draw by 20%+ for same week
trade_logic.exit: After 4 weeks or once storage levels stabilize within historical 5-year range

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Winter months (Nov-Mar) see 5%+ weekly draws 8-12 times per season due to temperature volatility.

idea: News Sentiment Spike on Antitrust Actions Crushes Tech Giants

data.source: RSS news feed counts (major outlets: Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC) tracking 'antitrust' + 'technology' via rss_count adapter

behavior: Major antitrust action announcements (DOJ, EU, FTC) trigger 200%+ daily spikes in regulatory news mentions. These often precede legislative/judicial developments that pressure mega-cap tech valuations.

market_impact.rationale: Tech megacaps face breakup risk and margin pressure from antitrust scrutiny; market reprices on headline volume.

trade_logic.entry: If daily RSS count for 'antitrust + technology' exceeds prior 30-day average by 150% AND count > 50 articles
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or once daily count falls below 80% of peak for 5 consecutive days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Regulatory actions fire 6-10 times per year; each generates 150%+ spike lasting 5-10 days.

idea: Supply Chain Backlog RSS Surge Signals Industrial Input Shortage

data.source: RSS news feed counts (major outlets) tracking 'supply chain backlog' + 'semiconductor' OR 'chip' OR 'component' via rss_count adapter

behavior: Supply chain disruptions (fab outages, port strikes, geopolitical shocks) trigger 100-300% daily spikes in logistics news. These precede production delays and industrial margin compression.

market_impact.rationale: Industrials face delayed input delivery and margin pressure; construction, automotive, electronics all affected.

trade_logic.entry: If daily RSS count for 'supply chain backlog' OR 'chip shortage' exceeds prior 30-day average by 120% AND count > 40 articles
trade_logic.exit: After 4 weeks or once daily count falls to 70% of prior 30-day baseline for 7 days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Logistics disruptions spike 8-12 times per year; each generates 120%+ spike lasting 7-21 days.
